title: Invite friends
lede: A friend who signs up with your code gets 50 credits after finishing the guide and creating a first project. If they accept a first delivery within 7 days of signing up, they get 100 more, and you get 150 credits and 50 points.

code.title: Your invite code
code.label: Invite code
code.unlockHint: Accept your first delivery to add {n} more seats

earned.title: Rewards earned
earned.note: Invitations earn at most 1,500 credits a month; beyond that only points are recorded. Credits last 90 days and are used after the month's plan credits.
